framework.name: Daybreak 出場框架 v3
framework.unit: 以「100% ＝ 本週期打算賣出的全部持倉」計，不涉及任何人的實際持倉
framework.unit_en: Measured as "100% = everything you plan to sell this cycle"; no one's actual holdings are involved

hedge.rule: 收盤連 5 日在 200 日均線之下 → 減 20%；連 5 日收回或 MVRV Z 7 日均 < 0.5 → 補回
hedge.rule_en: Close below the 200-day MA for 5 straight days → cut 20%; buy back after 5 straight closes above it, or when the MVRV Z 7-day average < 0.5

onchain.rule: MVRV ÷ 前一輪高點連 5 日 ≥ 0.75 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: MVRV ÷ prior-cycle peak ≥ 0.75 for 5 straight days → sell one step

onchain.rule: 連 5 日 ≥ 0.80 → 再賣一階
onchain.rule_en: ≥ 0.80 for 5 straight days → sell one more step

onchain.rule: 前兩條觸發過後，每次收盤創新高但 MVRV ≤ 一年最高的 0.9 倍 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: After both have fired: each new closing high with MVRV ≤ 0.9× its 1-year high → sell one step

framework.top3: MVRV Z／NUPL／Puell 四年百分位任兩項 ≥ 80 標為頂部區，只作讀值、不連動賣出。原本的加速規則（≥ 85 多賣兩階、≥ 90 全部賣完）在過去四輪都於週期中段先觸發，2026-11-05 取消
framework.top3_en: Any two of the MVRV Z / NUPL / Puell 4-year percentiles at ≥ 80 marks the top zone; a reading only, with no selling attached. The old acceleration rule (≥ 85 sell two extra steps, ≥ 90 sell everything) fired mid-cycle first in all four past cycles and was dropped on 2026-11-05
framework.time_stop: 2029/10–2030/03 剩餘部位每月等量賣完
framework.time_stop_en: 2029/10–2030/03: sell the remainder in equal monthly amounts

title.zh: MVRV Z 到近一年最低的 2%

means.zh: 市值相對總成本偏低（估值冷）：歷來低檔接近週期底部。
means.en: Market value is low relative to total cost (cold valuation): lows have historically been near cycle bottoms.

rule.zh: 把近一年每天的數值排名，今天落在最低的 2%（第 0.0 百分位）。
rule.en: Ranked against every day of the last year, today is in the bottom 2% (percentile 0.0).

means.zh: 整體帳面獲利很薄甚至虧損：市場情緒偏悲觀到投降。
means.en: Paper profit is thin or negative: sentiment runs from pessimism to capitulation.

rule.zh: 把近一年每天的數值排名，今天落在最低的 2%（第 0.0 百分位）。
rule.en: Ranked against every day of the last year, today is in the bottom 2% (percentile 0.0).

title.zh: 短期持有者 SOPR 到近一年最低的 2%

caveat.zh: 日線，盤中集中認賠會被同一天的獲利賣出平均掉
caveat.en: daily; intraday capitulation gets averaged with same-day profit taking

decomp.zh: 拆解：和 7 天前比，實現獲利 −22.20%、實現虧損 +111.80%，主要是認賠變多
decomp.en: breakdown: versus 7 days ago, realized profit −22.20%, realized loss +111.80%; mainly more loss selling

means.zh: 短期持有者普遍賠錢賣：短期持有者在認賠出場，常出現在恐慌或回檔的低點附近；認賠潮過去後賣壓會減輕。
means.en: Short-term holders are selling at a loss: short-term holders are capitulating, typically near panic or pullback lows; selling pressure eases once the wave passes.

rule.zh: 把近一年每天的數值排名，今天落在最低的 2%（第 0.5 百分位）。
rule.en: Ranked against every day of the last year, today is in the bottom 2% (percentile 0.5).

title.zh: 每日淨實現損益到近一年最低的 2%
title.en: Daily net realized P/L at a 1-year low (bottom 2%)

means.zh: 全網一天實現的淨虧損很大：持有者在大量認賠，常見於恐慌下跌、局部低點附近。
means.en: The network realized a large net loss in one day: heavy loss-selling, common in panic drops near local lows.

rule.zh: 把近一年每天的數值排名，今天落在最低的 2%（第 0.8 百分位）。
rule.en: Ranked against every day of the last year, today is in the bottom 2% (percentile 0.8).

title.zh: 穩定幣供給 7 日急降

means.zh: 穩定幣供給快速減少：資金從加密市場撤出（贖回成美元），可以用來買幣的子彈變少。
means.en: Stablecoin supply is shrinking fast: money is leaving crypto (redeemed for dollars), leaving less dry powder to buy with.

rule.zh: 和 7 天前比的變化，放進近一年每天的 7 日變化排名，落在跌得最多的 2%（第 0.8 百分位）。
rule.en: The change versus 7 days ago ranks in the 2% largest drops of the past year (percentile 0.8).

title.zh: MVRV ÷ 前一輪高點 7 日急降
title.en: MVRV ÷ prior cycle peak: sharp 7-day drop

means.zh: MVRV 相對前一輪高點一週內明顯下降：估值離前一輪頂部更遠。
means.en: MVRV relative to the prior cycle peak fell sharply this week: valuation is moving away from last cycle's top.

rule.zh: 和 7 天前比的變化，放進近一年每天的 7 日變化排名，落在跌得最多的 2%（第 1.7 百分位）。
rule.en: The change versus 7 days ago ranks in the 2% largest drops of the past year (percentile 1.7).

title.zh: 加權資金費率翻負（空方付費）

means.zh: 永續合約改由空方付費給多方：槓桿偏空，若價格上漲容易出現軋空。
means.en: Perpetual shorts now pay longs: leverage leans short, so a rally can turn into a short squeeze.

rule.zh: 和上一期（前一天的資料）比，這個狀態翻過來了。每天只比較前後兩期，所以只有翻轉當天會出現，之後幾天標「第 N 天」。
rule.en: Compared with the previous edition (the prior day's data), this state flipped. Only consecutive editions are compared, so it fires on the day of the flip and then counts days.

fig.zh: MVRV ÷ 前一輪高點 7 日急降、MVRV Z 到近一年最低的 2%、NUPL 到近一年最低的 2%、獲利供給比例到近一年最低的 2%
fig.en: MVRV ÷ prior cycle peak: sharp 7-day drop; MVRV Z at a 1-year low (bottom 2%); NUPL at a 1-year low (bottom 2%); Supply in profit at a 1-year low (bottom 2%)

means.en: Several signals of the same kind fired together: one indicator alone can be noise, several moving at once deserve more attention; see each one for its meaning.

rule.zh: 同一類有 3 項以上同時異動（這次 4 項）。
rule.en: Three or more signals of the same kind at once (4 this time).
